name: Dublin 3
coverage_notes: Research is in progress with 42 catalogue records, including Marino, Clontarf village, the historic seafront, Castle Avenue, Seafield Road, Vernon Avenue, the former Clontarf Sheds waterfront, public-realm details, civic buildings and historic institutional sites. Discovery batches 001–008 document individually registered buildings, ruins, architectural details, Modernist promenade structures, transport infrastructure, sporting heritage, historic street furniture, memorials and surviving buildings in the former fishing-village landscape. This remains an opening sample, not comprehensive district coverage; founder photography and on-site coordinate verification remain outstanding. Operational fieldwork zone only; not an administrative boundary.
